desc:
Welcome to Mint Tycoon, the Bank of Robloxia's newest banking themed tycoon game! Although still in beta, this game contains hours of playtime, three difficulty game modes,  and raw materials just waiting to be processed into currency. Make precious metal coins and even your favorite Robloxian bills (Tix & Robux) to trade at the exchange for cash! Maybe "building off of the success of others" is more your style. No problem! With advances in Hackdar ™ technology you can play against your peer's vault defenses for the underground market in the hopes of accelerating your chances for success!

Want more info on future updates? To receive a special Beta Player rank, see upcoming feature demos, and have the opportunity to give us your ideas, join Bank of Robloxia linked to this game!

Thank you so much for playing!
Please feel free to reach out with any feedback, bugs, or concerns.

[Changelog]:
1.) Winter Update released! (New mint & game mode!)
